the integration of universal streams into component applications is feasible and that it can be achieved by means of the CORBAservices framework.

a component model for distributed data stream applications, which are based on the integration of universal media streams.
the design and implementation of a component model for the development of distributed data stream processing systems that can be used to build complex data stream processing applications.

the design, implementation, and evaluation of a component technology for universal data streams that can be used for the design and implementation of complex distributed stream processing applications.

a component model for data stream processing has to provide the means for the integration of data stream components, the definition of the data stream interfaces, the definition of data stream services and the specification of the data stream processing logic.
the presented work is a step towards the development of a component model for distributed data stream applications.
a component model for data stream processing is a promising approach for the development of distributed data stream processing systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the presented framework allows for the integration and processing of data streams in a distributed component environment.

the presented approach provides a solid theoretical foundation for the integration of data streams into component applications and that it can be applied for the design of data-stream-enabled components.
we provide a component meta-model for universal data streams and a container that supports this model.

the CORBA component meta-model can be extended in a straightforward way to accommodate the integration of data streams into components.
the integration of data streams into component technology can be done by extending the meta-model for component technology and the container.
